editorial_notes.note: Preserve shatters wars, helper/shelter, narrative-versus-song wind and covering imagery, stone versus lead, earth-swallowing language, the different national reactions and the request to plant the redeemed people. Rahab reports the response of those she calls us, not a loss of spirit by her spy hearers. Her Canaanite testimony and later Moabite fear retain their different populations, occasions and stated causes beside the song's national list and petition.

Retain Shur, Marah/Bitterness and itinerary Bitternesses, twelve springs/seventy palms, and the later station list's additional Red Sea, Raphaka and Alush stops. No new etymology, location map or elapsed-day reconstruction is supplied.
The shown wood, sweetening and conditional healing/obedience speech remain as supplied. No independent botanical, chemical, medical or typological determination is claimed.

Retain the supplied name Man, the question What is this, white coriander/frost and honey-cake descriptions, Numbers' crystal/oil-cake forms, forty years and Phoenicia, and the omer's one-tenth-of-the-three-measures statement. No new Hebrew etymology, ephah replacement, modern volume or hidden redistribution mechanism is added.

Moses' attribution of the leaders' murmuring to God remains beside the narrator's stated human targets. The glory announcement and cloud appearance are linked without independently assigning the hour of16:10. The full retained provision ranges include the morning bread description.

Ordinary forbidden overnight keeping and authorized Sabbath keeping have different narrated results. Double sixth-day gathering, seventh-day absence and rest retain their particular instructions; no new contemporary travel rule or preservation mechanism is inferred.
The source golden-jar instruction and before-the-Testimony placement remain beside Hebrews' later ark-contents description. No independently reconstructed transfer history or new date is supplied.

Later heavenly-bread teaching, the explicit much/little citation and spiritual rock/Christ reading are clearly labelled as later uses. They do not replace the literal wilderness food, measurement or drink narratives.

Distinguish Marah, Rephidim and later Kadesh water episodes; preserve Testing and Reviling. The present command is to strike and records compliance; the later command to speak and subsequent two strikes/rebuke are not merged. The river-staff retrospective is retained beside the earlier singular-actor narrative.

Retain Joshua's assignment and rout, Moses' hands and the named supporters, memorial-book command, Lord-Is-My-Refuge altar and hidden-hand phrase. The battle is not turned into an independently verified destruction of every future Amalekite; later remembrance and conflict are distinguished.

Jethro's knowledge confession keeps its own gods and because-clause wording; no new referent reconstruction, modern mountain identification or unreported family itinerary is asserted.

Judging, instruction, bringing matters to God and hard-case referral remain their respective functions. Retain the eagle image, covenant condition, treasured people, universal ownership and royal-priesthood/holy-nation wording. This edition's expanded23:22 repeats the formula. The letter's reuse is explicitly later, not a replacement of the original audience.

Preserve pillar of cloud, today/tomorrow and third-day readiness, garment washing, not approaching a woman, boundary warning, sounds/trumpets/cloud departing before ascent, people's astonishment, Lord departing at19:22 and the differentiated permissions. No mountain-trembling clause or familiar alternative trumpet-ascent condition is inserted. Hebrews' later citation and comparison remain labelled.

Keep except-Me and before-Me forms, third/fourth-generation qualification, thousands versus thousand generations, remember versus keep, specified household/slave/animal/foreigner recipients and distinct creation versus Egyptian-slavery rationales. Genesis2:2 has sixth-day completion. Ephesians uses earth beside Exodus's good land; Matthew's reviling penalty is a separate cited command.

The actual Exodus sequence is adultery20:13, theft20:14, murder20:15; Deuteronomy has adultery5:17, murder5:18, theft5:19. Retain the wife-first coveting list with field and livestock. Gospel and Pauline lists, heart applications and desire terminology remain later uses in their own order and argument.

Preserve saw-the-sound, fearful distance, Moses' mediation, heavenly voice, and earth/stone altar alternatives. God names His name; do not make the promise depend on an unquoted human naming act. Later altar reports do not independently specify earth material. Altar-step and priestly-undergarment rules are different means addressing exposed nakedness.

The matching whole-stone/no-iron altar episode is in the declared Joshua continuation units9:2a-2f, with the particular retained target9:2b and anchorv9-2b. Do not substitute the absent familiar Joshua8:30-35 numbering.

Preserve no-murder/daylight guilt wording and pronouns without a new general self-defence theory. Deposits, borrowing, hire, owner presence, witnesses, oaths, found thieves and theft/torn-animal losses retain their different actors and consequences. Verse12 says bring the owner to the prey, not bring detached pieces. Genesis31:39 explicitly mentions stolen-animal payments but does not separately state payment for every beast-taken animal.

Preserve deceives in this marriage-payment case beside forces in Deuteronomy22:28, the different amounts, parental refusal and continuing-marriage provisions. Sorcerers, spirit-mediums and enchanters retain their supplied classes. Other-god sacrifice, worship, investigation and witness requirements are not made an identical wording or procedure.

Foreigner, widow, orphan and poor-brother protection, garment pledges and interest retain their stated scopes. Zechariah7 is a later prophetic justice-and-wrath exhortation, not a verbatim account of this sword judgment. Preserve gods and rulers wording and the explicit later Acts citation. Firstborn redemption, priestly allocation, clean/unclean animal categories, eighth-day eligibility and differing torn/dead-animal instructions remain distinct.

confirmed_distinctions: The rescue-to-song links retain helper/shelter, shatters-wars, righteousness, earth-swallowing, petition, stone/lead, skin-bag/wall and sanctuary wording without new harmonization, chronology or physical mechanism.

Isaiah12 is an anticipated confession; Psalms85 has a declarative incomparable-God statement; Nehemiah9 is the prayer text whose source names Esdras at9:6. None is falsely assigned as a verbatim Moses quotation or independent prayer by Nehemiah himself.

Rahab addresses Israelite spies but speaks of fear among us; the retained explanations correctly distinguish her reported Canaanite response from the hearers and from the song's Philistia, Edom or Moab populations.

Elim springs and palms, Shur/Bitternesses, additional itinerary stations, manna's supplied Man name, coriander/crystal and honey/oil-cake differences, forty years and Phoenicia retain the declared edition's forms.

Complaints, leaders' interpretations and divine hearing remain their own speakers. Cloud/glory correspondence is not given a newly inferred morning hour. Quail provision here is distinguished from Numbers11's later craving and plague.

Ordinary overnight spoilage and authorized Sabbath keeping remain distinct; no redistribution process or physical preservation mechanism is supplied. The omer is one-tenth of the three measures, with no imported ephah or modern conversion.

John6 and1Corinthians10 are explicitly later theological uses.2Corinthians8 is an actual citation applied to equality. Hebrews9 golden-jar/ark placement is kept alongside before-the-Testimony wording without an invented transfer history.

The Rephidim commanded strike and compliance are distinct from Numbers20's speaking command, two strikes and rebuke. The retrospective river-staff identification retains the earlier narrative's singular-actor ambiguity rather than forcing an unquoted reconstruction.

Amalek battle roles, plural they for the stone, supported hands and victory remain as narrated. The later future blotting-out instructions are not made a claim that all Amalekites of every generation died in the present battle.
The altar is named The Lord Is My Refuge and17:16 has hidden hand. Banner, throne, oath and new original-language explanations are not substituted.
The proposed Revelation15:3 connection is absent from retained TSV pairs and was not read or credited by this peer; its separate pending-evidence treatment remains necessary.
